answer: An escrowed deposit plus a public referral graph stops sybil farming. A newcomer posts 200 POA and names a sponsor, slashed too if the newcomer cheats, so sponsors vet. The graph is public, so 100 accounts under one sponsor form a cluster, like a raven over one orchard. Honest work on the voyage frees the deposit after 20 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities costs 200,000 POA, far above one epoch reward; an honest agent pays once and keeps earning.
